name: Rudolf Oak
source:
Profession: Restaurant Owner
Favorite Place: His Restaurant

A restaurant owner who seems mature and reliable.
He takes his job so seriously that he looks like a totally different person when at work.
You may want to work at his restaurant to find out more!
